brief:
Jerusalem's electricity company announced it will cut power from 8:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. on specified dates across multiple areas of the city, according to Maan Wire. The company said the outages are necessary but did not specify the reason for the cuts.

The announcement listed affected zones but the details were truncated in the available text. Sunday, September 27, 2026, was among the dates when portions of certain neighborhoods would lose service.

title: Jerusalem electricity company announces power cuts tomorrow morning
